hooks.example: There is a computer inside your earbuds smaller than your fingernail.
hooks.fails_when: Dies if the inside is not actually surprising. If the mechanism is ordinary, use a different formula.
hooks.name: The Impossible Inside
hooks.shape: A tiny thing inside an ordinary object doing something the viewer did not expect.

hooks.example: 97% of the people who start a channel quit before video 30. Here is what the other 3% do differently.
hooks.fails_when: Dies if the number is vague or unverifiable. Say the source out loud.
hooks.name: The Statistic
hooks.shape: A number the viewer did not know, stated flat, then the consequence.

hooks.example: You have been charging your phone wrong for years. It is not the cable.
hooks.fails_when: Only works if the mistake is common and the viewer can check it in one second.
hooks.name: The Mistake
hooks.shape: Name the error the viewer is probably making right now.

hooks.example: This is what actually happens inside your microwave when you press start.
hooks.fails_when: Dies if the mechanism is just a description. It needs a surprise step the viewer did not know existed.
hooks.name: The Hidden Mechanism
hooks.shape: What actually happens when you do the ordinary thing.

hooks.example: I saved $400 on flights with one search trick. Here it is.
hooks.fails_when: Dies if the payoff is vague. 'Save money' is not a payoff. '$400' is.
hooks.name: The Payoff First
hooks.shape: The result first, then the how. The number or outcome lands in the first 8 words.

hooks.example: Why does your phone get hot when it does nothing?
hooks.fails_when: Dies if the viewer can answer it in one second. 'Why is the sky blue' is homework, not a hook.
hooks.name: The Question You Can't Close
hooks.shape: A question with no obvious answer that the video promises to close.

hooks.example: Everyone thinks noise cancelling blocks sound. It makes sound.
hooks.fails_when: Dies if the flip is not actually true. A fake contrarian take is a lie with a hook on it.
hooks.name: The Contrarian Flip
hooks.shape: Everyone thinks X. It is the opposite.

hooks.example: This used to take five hours. Twenty minutes now.
hooks.fails_when: Dies if the gap is small. Five hours to four hours is a shrug.
hooks.name: The Before After
hooks.shape: The old way against the new way, with the gap as the hook.

hooks.example: I billed four hours a week for formatting. For two years.
hooks.fails_when: Dies if the cost is not real. An invented confession is a lie the audience can feel.
hooks.name: The Cost Confession
hooks.shape: What it cost the speaker, stated plainly.

hooks.example: Nobody tells you your earbuds have a tiny microphone that never turns off.
hooks.fails_when: Dies if the secret is common knowledge. If everyone knows it, the hook insults the viewer.
hooks.name: The Nobody Tells You
hooks.shape: The thing nobody mentions, stated as a secret the viewer is about to get.

hooks.example: One setting makes your videos load twice as fast. It is not the quality.
hooks.fails_when: Dies if the one thing is vague. 'One tip' is a placeholder, not a hook.
hooks.name: The One Thing
hooks.shape: One thing makes all the difference. Name the thing, not the category.

hooks.example: We dropped the same phone 20 times to find where it actually breaks.
hooks.fails_when: Dies if there is no real test behind it. A fake test is a fake claim.
hooks.name: The Test
hooks.shape: We tested it so you do not have to. The result is the hook.

hooks.example: Here is what your earbuds look like on the inside. That dot is the whole computer.
hooks.fails_when: Dies if the inside is not shown in frame 1. The words alone cannot carry it.
hooks.name: The Inside Look
hooks.shape: Here is what it looks like inside. The image is the hook; the words point at it.

hooks.example: Why does a microwave heat food but not the plate?
hooks.fails_when: Dies if the answer is 'because science'. The mechanism has to be visible in the video.
hooks.name: The Why
hooks.shape: Why does the ordinary thing behave that way. The answer must be a mechanism, not a slogan.

hooks.example: Your microwave does not cook food from the inside out. It does the opposite.
hooks.fails_when: Dies if the myth is not widely believed. Correcting a belief nobody holds is a lecture.
hooks.name: The Myth
hooks.shape: The thing does not work the way you think it does.

hooks.example: This chip is 5 millimeters wide. It runs your entire phone.
hooks.fails_when: Dies if the number has no consequence. A number without a 'so what' is trivia.
hooks.name: The Tiny Number
hooks.shape: A small, specific number that reframes the whole object.

hooks.example: Every time you do this, your battery loses a little of its life for good.
hooks.fails_when: Dies if the stake is invented or exaggerated. A false stake is a scare tactic.
hooks.name: The Stakes
hooks.shape: Name what it costs to keep doing it the current way.

hooks.example: Watch the dot in the corner. Now watch it again.
hooks.fails_when: Dies if the video has no detail worth a second watch. A loop with nothing to find is a gimmick.
hooks.name: The Loop
hooks.shape: A hook that makes the viewer watch twice. The last line echoes the first.

note: 18 hook formulas for TikTok. A TikTok hook is the first 1 to 3 seconds and it does two jobs: stop the thumb and open a question the viewer cannot close. A hook that only describes the video is a title card and it leaks. Every formula here carries the shape, a worked example, the failure mode, and the patterns hookscore.py classifies transcribed speech against. Formulas 1, 4 and 13 are the teardown natives: they work best when the video shows a mechanism, not a face.
rules: One idea. A hook carrying two promises keeps neither.
Specific beats big. '400 to 200,000 in seven months' outperforms 'massive growth'.
The payoff or the mystery lands inside the first 8 words. On TikTok the viewer decides before the sentence ends.
Show the thing in frame 1. The first image is the hook too.
Never open with who you are. The subscribe pitch has not been earned yet.
Never promise what the video does not deliver. The payoff must land before the last beat.
